``` ::: ::: ## Read parquet directly - Dataset label in schema metadata - Column labels in field metadata. Both are bytes, decode to str ::: {#f837f4e2 .cell execution_count=10} ``` {.python .cell-code} from importlib import resources import pyarrow.parquet as pq path = resources.files("pharmadata") / "_data" / "pharmaverseadam" / "adsl.parquet" schema = pq.ParquetFile(path).schema_arrow print((schema.metadata or {}).get(b"label", b"").decode()) print({ name: (schema.field(name).metadata or {}).get(b"label", b"").decode() for name in schema.names[:3] }) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout} ``` Subject Level Analysis {'STUDYID': 'Study Identifier', 'USUBJID': 'Unique Subject Identifier', 'SUBJID': 'Subject Identifier for the Study'} ``` ::: ::: ::: {#1ac61979 .cell execution_count=11} ``` {.python .cell-code} pl.from_arrow(pq.read_table(path, columns=schema.names[:6])).head(5) ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=11} ```{=html}
